newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada family after-tax income flat in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Canada family after-tax income flat in 1995.

text.p: After-tax income for Canadian families was essentially unchanged in 1995 from 1994, after adjusting for inflation, Statistics Canada said on Monday.

Average after-tax family income in 1995, based on estimates derived from the annual survey of consumer finances, was C$44,286, about five percent less than in 1989, the peak year for income, StatsCan said.

In 1995, income excluding government transfer payments was up marginally from the 1994 level while transfer payments were down, the agency said. Since income taxes were basically the same, the net result was that average family income after tax was virtually unchanged.
